purpose: Per CEO R291 P1: 'ISO 7197 is specifically for sterile, single-use NON-ACTIVE hydrocephalus shunts and explicitly does NOT apply to active implants. P-01 is an active control system. Do not create false interpretation. Classify as REFERENCE/PARTIAL APPLICABILITY.'
constitutional_basis: Article X (honest disclosure). Article XXVIII (no silent semantic promotion).

iso_7197_scope.standard: ISO 7197:2024 — Neurosurgical implants — Sterile, single-use hydrocephalus shunts
iso_7197_scope.explicit_exclusion: Does NOT apply to active implants
iso_7197_scope.p_01_classification: ACTIVE control system (bounded-rate conductance control + sensor-health fallback + multi-segment redistribution)

correct_statement: ISO 7197:2024 provides relevant reference performance characteristics for shunt hardware. Applicability to the active P-01 system must be assessed separately. P-01 does NOT claim ISO 7197 compliance.

requirement_by_requirement_applicability.applicability: PARTIAL — applies to the passive valve hardware, not the active controller
requirement_by_requirement_applicability.why: The variable-orifice valves in P-01 are passive hydraulic components that have pressure-flow characteristics. ISO 7197 test methods can characterize these. But the ACTIVE control layer (rate-limited modulation) changes the effective pressure-flow behavior dynamically, which ISO 7197 does not address.
requirement_by_requirement_applicability.machine_action: Bench measures static pressure-flow per valve (ISO method) + dynamic pressure-flow under controller (P-01 method). Both reported separately.

requirement_by_requirement_applicability.applicability: PARTIAL — applies to mechanical valves, not to controller-modulated opening
requirement_by_requirement_applicability.why: The valves have mechanical opening/closing pressures. But P-01's controller modulates valve opening continuously, so 'opening pressure' is a controller-set parameter, not a mechanical property.
requirement_by_requirement_applicability.machine_action: Bench measures mechanical opening pressure (ISO method) AND controller-commanded opening range (P-01 method).

requirement_by_requirement_applicability.applicability: APPLIES — hydraulic resistance is a physical property of the tubing and valves
requirement_by_requirement_applicability.why: Hydraulic resistance is independent of whether the system is active or passive. It characterizes the fluid path.
requirement_by_requirement_applicability.machine_action: Bench measures hydraulic resistance per segment (ISO method). Directly applicable.

requirement_by_requirement_applicability.applicability: APPLIES — reflux prevention is a safety requirement regardless of active/passive
requirement_by_requirement_applicability.why: Reflux (backflow of distal fluid into the ventricle) is a safety hazard that must be prevented in any shunt system.
requirement_by_requirement_applicability.machine_action: Bench tests reflux prevention under reverse pressure (ISO method). Directly applicable.

requirement_by_requirement_applicability.applicability: APPLIES — mechanical integrity is required for any implant
requirement_by_requirement_applicability.why: The physical components (tubing, valves, reservoir) must meet mechanical performance requirements regardless of the control system.
requirement_by_requirement_applicability.machine_action: Bench verifies mechanical integrity of all components (ISO method). Directly applicable.

requirement_by_requirement_applicability.applicability: DOES NOT APPLY — P-01 is a controller design, not a sterile single-use product
requirement_by_requirement_applicability.why: P-01 is a technology package (control law + architecture + protocol). The buyer manufactures the physical product, which would be sterile and single-use. ISO 7197's sterility requirements apply to the buyer's final product, not to P-01's controller design.
requirement_by_requirement_applicability.machine_action: Note in TTP: sterility is the buyer's responsibility per their manufacturing process.

summary.buyer_TTP_statement: ISO 7197:2024 provides reference performance characteristics for shunt hardware components. P-01's active control system is NOT within ISO 7197's scope (non-active shunts only). Applicable ISO requirements (hydraulic resistance, reflux, mechanical integrity) are verified on the bench. Partially applicable requirements (pressure-flow, opening/closing) are measured both statically (ISO method) and dynamically (P-01 method). Sterility is the buyer's manufacturing responsibility.
